basis: Known-page evidence reproduces a DIVINITY reverse-Vigenere state and a prime-minus-one state; LP1/06 reproduces the fixed reverse-plus-three affine map.
FEED-011 requires a typed, source-limited DSL and warns that depth alone does not bound keys, resets or exception positions.
The user explicitly authorized a depth-at-most-three search, so only the four atoms and state contract below are admitted.
The v1 implementation audit found an A-atom constant mismatch and an unreachable Holm acceptance rule; this version fixes the atom and preregisters maxT as the family-wise page correction.
hypothesis: One common program made from the registered atoms produces a language score that generalizes from a fixed discovery page set to a fixed held-out page set.
falsifiable_predictions: A finite universe has exactly 49 grammar programs before source-independent algebraic deduplication; the deduplication does not use LP2 ciphertext or a private answer.
The synthetic gate runs the complete multi-page selection pipeline, recovers at least 18/20 verifier-known programs and accepts 0/99 public negatives under the fixed all-path scoring rule.

After a passed gate, the same selected program is scored on LP2/0..27 and then, without reselection, on LP2/28..55 excluding LP2/50; a lead requires both random-control families, the same at least two held-out pages, and maxT-adjusted p<=0.003.

applicable_objects: All 55 pages containing registered rune tokens; discovery D=LP2/0..27, holdout H=LP2/28..55 excluding LP2/50.

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune tokens; its alphanumeric grid is not converted into rune values.
Grid literals are hard boundaries and are not converted or used as hidden rune data.

representation: Rune ordinals 0..28, one page-local rune stream, original raw token metadata retained separately; non-runes do not consume state and no row/segment/grid reset is introduced.

atoms.PRIME_MINUS_ONE: reverse decoder with p_1=2 and delta_t=p_(t+1)-1

dsl.state_contract: Plaintext 0 is emitted unchanged and does not consume; every nonzero plaintext consumes one key/prime state. In reverse, C=0 has the explicit F branch and the normal branch is retained only when its decoded value is nonzero. All legal paths are retained.
dsl.scope: Each page starts state at zero; non-runes, rows, segments and grid literals do not consume or reset.
dsl.deduplication: Only source-independent symbol/operator equivalence is used; stateless equality is probed for every input 0..28 at fixed positions 0..1023. Stateful programs are not merged from observed-page output equality.
dsl.selection: 29-symbol first-order add-one model; sum likelihood over all legal state paths; page score is complete log likelihood divided by rune count; D is one program selected by score, then frozen for H. Ties use shortest depth then normalized dictionary order.

statistics.discovery: Equal-weight mean of page scores over D; each random control repeats D selection.
statistics.holdout: The D-selected program is evaluated on H without program, phase or mask reselection.
statistics.lead: Both control families complete, independent validation passes, and the same at least two holdout pages have maxT-adjusted p<=0.003 under both controls; Holm values are recorded descriptively but are not the decision rule. This remains only a structural language lead, not a plaintext solution.
statistics.negative: Gate and controls complete with no lead; scope is limited to this 49-program grammar and state contract.

power_gate.acceptance: At least 18/20 hidden expected programs rank first and 0/99 negatives reach the fixed positive score/selection acceptance; gate failure is inconclusive and does not dispatch LP2.
power_gate.holdout: Synthetic positive text windows are generated from heldout.txt; private plaintext, recipe and generation state remain verifier-only.

families: Per-page rune multiset permutation with raw markers untouched.
One common random S29 bijection over the whole corpus, preserving order and repeat structure.
controls.multiple_testing: Two declared null families, page selection and D selection are rerun per control; per-item alpha is 0.01/3=0.003. Page statistics use maxT over all H pages for each control family; Holm-adjusted values are retained as descriptive diagnostics only.

independent_validation_path: A guarded worker evaluates only public rune streams and model weights. The runner independently recomputes the state path recurrence, all-path log-sum, program universe, inverse synthetic encryption and control statistics without importing the worker implementation.
uncovered_parameters: unknown keys, offsets, skips or resets
